reviewNotes: HOLD — Ayii University's active official site presents a six-year Bachelor of Medicine & Bachelor of Surgery, a listed annual fee of USD 1,200, entry requirements and an online application process. It also publishes clinical-placement claims for Juba Teaching Hospital, Juba Civil Hospital, Munuki Health Centre and St. Mary's Medical Centre. All of these claims are first-party. The only 2025/26 application notice located is historical, and no independent current accreditation record, professional-recognition pathway, international-applicant procedure, language-of-instruction confirmation, accommodation/insurance evidence, or independently verified clinical agreement was found. The site should not convert this into a medical-study-abroad lead page; the record is retained only as a held research candidate.

sources.label: Ayii University — Bachelor Degree Programmes
sources.notes: Active page lists a six-year MBBS, curriculum progression and domestic/equivalent secondary-school entry conditions; it says applications are rolling.

sources.label: Ayii University — Fees and Tuition
sources.notes: Lists MBBS as six years with USD 1,200 annual fee and semester/annual payment options. It does not provide a full international cost of attendance or fee effective date.

sources.label: Ayii University — Admissions
sources.notes: Sets out application documents and process; the listed key dates are for 2025, so they are not represented as a current intake calendar.

sources.label: Ayii University — Internship and attachments
sources.notes: Claims clinical placement partners and a six-month placement. Those details require independent confirmation before any student-facing clinical-training promise.

sources.label: Ayii University — About
sources.notes: Institution claims full accreditation from the South Sudan Higher Education Authority. No government/regulator source confirming programme-level status was located in this bounded pass.
